title: NodeGX — what's new
description: Release notes shown in the NodeGX editor. An empty items list means there is nothing to announce; the editor treats that as a normal state and opens no modal.

items.title: NodeGX 0.4.2
items.content_html:
NodeGX 0.4.2

Upload File can keep a photo for members only. Its new Readers input names the roles, such as role:member, that can open a private file.

Upload File can make a photo smaller before sending it. Set its new Shrink To input to the longest side in pixels.

A webhook trigger can check Paystack's signature. Choose Paystack signature for the hook in the backend's admin app.

Everything in 0.4.2
